misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen forecast specification linked to its issuance time, evidence cutoff, and later realized outcome could make a prospective forecast audit possible. The supplied settlement records alone cannot show that any decision or forecast failed.
misses.decision_reference: No eligible prior decision or forecast specification is linked to these settlement records. The registry identifies this gap under EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE.
misses.decision_relevance: Confirmed target-time prices are present, but the evidence says settlement capture time is an adjudication target—not a source observation or decision time—and that prior forecast specifications and cutoffs are missing.
misses.miss_description: Decision-miss status is undetermined: the supplied evidence documents missing forecast lineage, not a demonstrated decision failure.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent. Target-time settlement prices cannot establish what was knowable beforehand or whether a forecast missed.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement records provide confirmed target-time BTC/ETH mark prices, but the registry states they are not linked to available prior forecast specifications; no supported miss outcome is established.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
